headline: President Clinton named Yugoslavia (Serbia and Montenegro), Albania, and their airspace and nearby waters an official combat zone in 1999.
what_it_does: This order officially labels the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (Serbia and Montenegro), Albania, the airspace above them, and nearby waters as a combat zone. Under federal law, a combat zone label usually gives tax benefits to US military members serving there, such as not paying federal income tax on some of their pay. The title alone does not spell out the exact benefits or dates.

who_it_affects.group: US military members serving in or over Yugoslavia, Albania, or nearby waters
who_it_affects.how: They may qualify for tax benefits that federal law gives to people serving in a combat zone.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 13, 1999; the title does not state the exact start date of the combat zone.
